title: Tanium Client directory and subsequent files must be excluded from On-Access scan.
check_content:
Review the settings of the antivirus software.

Validate exclusions exist that exclude the Tanium Client directory and subsequent file interactions from On-Access scans. 

If exclusions do not exist, this is a finding.
fixtext: Implement exclusion policies within the antivirus software solution to exclude the On-Access scanning of Tanium Client directory and subsequent file interactions.
VulnDiscussion: Similar to any other host-based applications, the Tanium Client is subject to the restrictions other system-level software may place on an operating environment. Antivirus, intrusion prevention system (IPS), encryption, or other security and management stack software may disallow the Client from working as expected.
